prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished raster concept of a vertically scrolling Vietnamese mobile idle racing game's Shop, Soft Miniature style. This is a new concept, not runtime UI. Use the four input images as visual REFERENCES ONLY. Reference 1 chain_offer_shop_v1.png is the PRIMARY and closest approved standard: preserve its cream and blue card language, beige inset outlines, soft rounded edges, dark navy rounded bold typography, large glossy orange purchase buttons, pale cyan pill chips, little reward inset boxes containing icon plus number, sculpted toy-like 3D miniatures. Reference 2 shop_v9/shop.png supports shop hierarchy; reference 3 06-shop.png supports blue section banners and miniature icon design; reference 4 perk_card_income_x2_variants.png supports clay materials and card finish. Do NOT reproduce the old content or old prices.

COMPOSITION: one very tall mobile scroll image, portrait, approximately 390 logical pixels wide by 1500–1900 logical pixels tall, rendered at high resolution for sharp Vietnamese text (about 886 pixels wide, as tall as necessary). Full bleed Shop scroll, no device frame, no presentation labels, no comparison panels. Small partly clipped and softly blurred adjacent shop card at the very top and a partly clipped blurred section below give context, with NO legible extra offers or prices. TWO complete new shop sections stacked vertically in between. Keep cream background and compact sensible spacing, content fills width with narrow margins like reference 1. Blue section bars with 3D gift icon on left and light checkered race flag on right. Make all required content visible, no cropping. NO top HUD or bottom navigation needed.

SECTION ONE:
Blue banner EXACT text "ƯU ĐÃI GIỚI HẠN".
ONE large rounded cream outer card headed "GÓI GIỚI HẠN".
Below heading, pale blue rounded chip with clock icon and EXACT text "Làm mới sau 4 ngày 12 giờ".
Within card THREE equally sized vertical package subcards arranged in THREE COLUMNS, side by side. Each column has small price/value label, beautiful 3D gift/chest illustration ascending size small / medium / large, THREE stacked inset reward rows with clear icons, amounts and tiny readable resource type text, then "Giới hạn 1 lần", then action button. Do not add invented multipliers, use listed price as the small value label.
Column 1: small label "$2,99", small chest; reward rows in order: purple gem icon + "100 gem"; red ticket with white star + "×7" and "Vé tay đua Pro"; blue and gold ticket with gear symbol + "×7" and "Vé gear Tiêu chuẩn". Text can wrap within column. "Giới hạn 1 lần". This is the PURCHASED example: neutral gray rounded button with checkmark + "ĐÃ MUA"; soften the illustration slightly but keep reward values legible. Its original price remains visible in small label above.
Column 2: small label "$4,99", medium chest; reward rows: gem "255 gem"; Pro driver ticket "×13" and "Vé tay đua Pro"; Standard gear ticket "×13" and "Vé gear Tiêu chuẩn". "Giới hạn 1 lần". Orange buy button "$4,99".
Column 3: small label "$9,99", largest rich gift chest. A SMALL gold/orange badge EXACT text "GIÁ TRỊ NHẤT". Reward rows: gem "520 gem"; Pro driver ticket "×20" and "Vé tay đua Pro"; Standard gear ticket "×20" and "Vé gear Tiêu chuẩn". "Giới hạn 1 lần". Orange buy button "$9,99".
Keep all three subcard bottoms aligned. Resource icons identical between columns. Do not mistakenly use Elite gear or gold All-Star tickets.

SECTION TWO:
Blue banner EXACT text "CHỌN MỘT".
ONE large rounded cream outer card headed "GÓI CHỌN MỘT".
A pale blue clock chip EXACT text "Làm mới sau 4 ngày 12 giờ".
A single segmented row of FOUR tabs, each with its own small price underneath its tab label:
"S" / "$1,99"; "M" / "$4,99"; "L" / "$7,99"; "TẤT CẢ" / "$9,99".
M is SELECTED and orange, other three tabs cream/pale blue. Above or attached to TẤT CẢ a small legible badge "TIẾT KIỆM 33%". Let final tab be wider to accommodate the longer label. Show only M tab content below, do not create S or L detail panels.
M content title EXACT "Mảnh tay đua Elite".
Hero illustration: a soft miniature bag of driver shards, containing a friendly racing driver PORTRAIT on a collectible fragment card with a star-shaped jigsaw shard, with a few purple gems and red Pro driver tickets around its base; light blue sky inset like chain reference. Illustration supports rather than replaces the reward rows.
Large price "$4,99".
THREE prominent cream inset reward rows: purple gem icon + "150 gem"; portrait/star-fragment icon + "×10 mảnh tay đua Elite"; red Pro ticket icon + "×8 vé tay đua Pro".
Large glossy orange buy button "$4,99".
Below the outer card, clearly readable modest gray-navy caption EXACT text, wrap onto two or three lines as needed:
"TẤT CẢ gồm cả ba gói S + M + L: $9,99 thay vì $14,97".

CRITICAL: All Vietnamese accents must be correct, clean highly readable rounded font. Every number and price exactly as specified. Decimal commas. Do not add any rewards, prices, countdowns, packages, currencies, multipliers or claims beyond this specification. Reference-only data not to draw: S would be 50 gem + 10 Pro shards + 5 Pro tickets; L would be 320 gem + 10 Legend shards + 13 Pro tickets; do not show these rewards because M is selected. Total TẤT CẢ is $9,99; do not 'correct' its caption math. No watermark. Faithfully match primary chain reference's luxurious playful cream/blue/orange Soft Miniature artwork.

notes: Generated aspect ratio is more compact than the optional ~390x1900 tall layout; both complete sections are visible.
